prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1090
Claimant:
Nicole Wood
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
2024-05-20
First notice of loss received from the insured's representative regarding a side impact collision at a controlled
intersection involving the insured vehicle and a second vehicle. The claimant reports a knee injury and has retained
counsel.
2024-07-14
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named driver and coverage was in force at
the time of loss.
2024-07-28
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed representation and asked that all future contact go through their
office. The account of the collision was provided in writing and matches the initial report.
2024-08-27
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of impact and records the collision as
described. The responding officer noted the points of impact on both vehicles.
2024-08-29
Interviewed two independent witnesses at the scene, who each confirmed the collision happened as the claimant
described and that the claimant was seated in the driver's vehicle.
2024-09-08
Reviewed scene and vehicle photographs. The damage pattern on the claimant's vehicle lines up with the side impact
described, and the damage on the other vehicle is consistent with the same event.
2024-09-14
Took a recorded statement from the other driver, who independently confirmed the sequence of events and the signal
status at the intersection.
2024-09-26
Checked prior claim and damage history for the vehicle and found no earlier damage recorded to the same areas.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
2024-10-20
Received medical reocrds showing treatment for a knee injury. The injury is the kind expected from this type of force,
and no prior injury to the same knee appears in the records reviewed.
2024-11-03
Treatment followed a typical course, with therapy and follow-up visits tapering as the claimant's condition improved
and the treating provider noted steady progress.
2024-11-04
Reviewed the claimant's statements from each contact so far. The account of the collision and the injury has stayed
the same across every conversation and in the written submission.
2024-12-14
Current assessment: liability and coverage are consistent with the documentation, the injury and vehicle damage fit
the described impact, and the file is being prepared for continued handling through counsel.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
